name: PWA water resources facts and figures
contents: National water balance: WB available 221 Mm3 (wells 106.8 + springs 28.3 + PURCHASED FROM ISRAELI COMPANIES 85.9 = 39% of WB supply); Gaza 178.7 Mm3; domestic 245.4 Mm3 = 61%; per-capita 79.8 L/c/d vs 120 recommended; losses >30% WB / >40% Gaza; >97% of Gaza coastal aquifer fails WHO standards.

fills_gap: water quantities — AND the only affirmative data-reuse grant from any Palestinian institution surveyed
traps: CRUEL IRONY: the one openly-licensed source publishes its breakdowns as BITMAPS (jpeg/png) — OCR or manual transcription only. NO YEAR STATED anywhere — may be disqualifying for a time-series databank; write to PWA. Site emits broken image URLs (Windows backslashes + spurious /pwa prefix); resolve with forward slashes, URL-encode Arabic segments. Footer asserts all-rights-reserved, contradicting the data-use policy (policy should govern; conflict recorded).

name: PERC annual electricity sector performance reports
contents: 124pp text PDF, per-distribution-company (JDECO/NEDCO/HEPCO/TEDCO/SELCO). VERIFIED 2024: consumers 649,769 (+4%; Jerusalem 371,873, North 139,098, Hebron 70,215, South 45,210, Tubas 23,373); by class residential 510,637 / commercial 101,018 / industrial 4,137. Renewable generation 281,372,041 kWh (components sum exactly). SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI 2022-2024 split by responsibility. Residential tariff blocks 0.4725→0.6943 NIS/kWh. Consumer debt 1,660M NIS (2024) vs 2,030M (2023). Editions 2015-2024.

fills_gap: the single best-structured Palestinian electricity dataset found — could stand up the energy category alone
traps: TLS misconfigured: valid leaf cert served with MISMATCHED intermediate — strict clients fail. Do NOT disable verification in production; pin the leaf. Real site is one directory down (/perc/). WEST BANK ONLY (no GEDCO/Gaza). Arabic-only; front matter uses Arabic-Indic numerals, tables use Western. All-rights-reserved: ingest extracted FACTS with attribution, never republish tables.

name: WSRC water & wastewater service provider performance reports
contents: Per-provider fact sheets, ~150 providers across 10 WB governorates, two-year comparatives. VERIFIED (Jericho Municipality 02M01, 2023-2024): available resources 4,706,582 m3; network 211.54 km; 38,044 served; 7,642 connections; NRW 26%→29%; per-capita 210.56→206.38 l/c/d; selling price 2.97→3.05 NIS/m3; collection efficiency 62%→49%. Annex 1 goes to village-council grain.

fills_gap: water quantities at an order of magnitude finer grain than JMP percentages — richest verified water source found
traps: HTTP 406 to default curl UA — browser UA mandatory. GAZA ABSENT from 2024 edition (WSRC states it could not collect due to suspension/displacement/destruction) — treat as WB only. MIXED REFERENCE YEARS inside one edition (7+ sheets still labelled 2021-2022) — never assume uniform year from the cover. Flagship file 49.8MB/296pp, extraction times out — chunk. Arabic in bidi presentation forms — normalise. WRIS database login-walled and HTTP-only.

name: PCBS press-release corpus (monthly CPI + quarterly LFS)
contents: Sub-annual official statistics as structured press releases. VERIFIED: Q4-2025 unemployment 27.5%, labour underutilization 30.0%; WB unemployed ~280k (Q4-2025) vs ~293k (Q3-2025); embedded series 'Unemployment Rate (ICLS 19th) in the West Bank, Q1-2023 - Q4-2025'. NEGATIVE FINDING: the PCBS PXWeb API is DEAD — every documented path 404s against the new Umbraco site.
span: LFS Q1-2023→Q4-2025 in one release; archive deeper

name: PCHR incident documentation corpus (open WP REST API)
publisher: Palestinian Centre for Human Rights, Gaza
contents: VERIFIED: X-WP-Total 11,777 posts, 118 pages, deep pagination + incremental (?after=) both work. Categories: weekly-reports EN 1,140, AR 301, press-releases 3,848, Genocide Updates 294, field-updates 707, annual-report 30. Incident-level narrative with named individuals, ages, sub-daily timestamps, neighbourhood-level places, running YTD cumulatives.

license.name: no statement found

fills_gap: deepest, longest-running Palestinian incident archive with a real machine-readable path — but NOT open-licensed
traps: LICENCE IS VAPOUR — the site advertises terms it never wrote; written permission required. NO STRUCTURED TABLES ANYWHERE (60 recent posts: zero HTML tables) — every figure needs NLP extraction; aggregates live in 37-70MB PDFs. THE 20-YEAR WEEKLY SERIES TERMINATES EXACTLY AT THE WAR'S ONSET (nothing after 2023-10-05) — a continuous series must stitch two differently-structured categories. Bilingual = separate posts, join by category. Recent casualty figures attributed to MoH — double-count risk against T4P.

Year series 2000=123, 2009=1,058, 2014=2,240, 2023=2. (2) ~54 named-victim family case files (2014 war only) with full name/age lists.

name: JDECO annual reports
contents: 148pp text PDF for the largest Palestinian distributor, uniquely spanning Jerusalem/Ramallah/Jericho/Bethlehem INCLUDING EAST JERUSALEM. VERIFIED 2024: loss rate 18.28%; peak load 660.5 MW; 371,874 subscribers; energy purchased per branch (GWh) Jerusalem 1,089.65, Ramallah 1,220.23, Jericho 514.86, Bethlehem 306.47. Thirteen reports 2011-2024.

name: PMA monetary/banking statistics — LEAD ONLY, DO NOT PURSUE AS SCOUTED
contents: PMA is the central-bank-equivalent publisher of Palestine's monetary and banking statistics — the only Palestinian source for banking aggregates at monthly grain, which PCBS does not publish. NO DATA WAS OBSERVED: contents, span and cadence are inferred from PMA's mandate and site navigation only.
